scope: The frozen additional raw-cited Gyeonggi law-original queue, separately from the 554 official-page attachments and 981 other candidate originals.

limitations: Reading a body does not approve any benefit association. Current law, jurisdiction, purpose, author, intake and individual association checks remain separate.
Many originals are institutional registers, administrative or already-issued documents, not forms for a new applicant.
Private review bodies and rendered research copies are excluded from Git; this report preserves original IDs, SHA and review-input hashes only.
The 981 other candidates are a separate scope; their whole-body completion is not asserted here.
